info.title: dotnet-runic
info.description: Generated-command development coordination for Runic Views Window projects.

commands.name: completion
commands.description: Generate bash, zsh, fish or PowerShell completions

commands.name: dev
commands.description: Run the application with development watchers.

options.name: --no-restore
options.description:
Skip the .NET restore and the JavaScript package install. The build does
not install missing frontend packages either.

options.name: --no-frontend-watch
options.description:
Build the frontend once instead of starting its development server or
watcher.

options.name: --no-dotnet-watch
options.description:
Run the application once instead of restarting it under dotnet watch
after C# edits.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Print the evaluated project configuration and exit without changing files
or starting processes.

options.name: --project
options.description:
The project file, or a directory with one .csproj. Defaults to the
current directory.

arguments.name: APPLICATION_ARGUMENTS
arguments.description: Arguments after -- are passed to the application.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check the project and development environment.

options.name: --self-contained
options.description: With --rid, check a publish with --self-contained true.

options.name: --project
options.description:
The project file, or a directory with one .csproj. Defaults to the
current directory.

options.name: --configuration
options.description:
The build configuration to evaluate. Defaults to Debug, or Release
with --rid as dotnet publish does.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description:
Fail when a check reaches this status: never, fail or warn. Defaults
to fail for human output and never for JSON output.

options.name: --runtime
options.description:
Also check deployment prerequisites for this runtime identifier, for
example linux-x64, win-x64 or osx-arm64.

commands.name: size
commands.description: Measure a published application and write a size report.

options.name: --verify-argument
options.description: An argument for the --verify executable. Repeat it for several arguments.

options.name: --project
options.description:
The project file, or a directory with one .csproj. Defaults to the
current directory.

options.name: --runtime
options.description: The runtime identifier to publish for, for example linux-x64. Required.

options.name: --report
options.description:
The JSON report to write. The file must not exist yet.
[default: runic-size.json]

options.name: --verify
options.description:
An executable to run after a successful publish, as a path or a command
on PATH, such as node. It receives the --verify-argument values, then the
publish directory and the published application's path. A nonzero exit
code fails the command.

commands.name: support
commands.description:
Preview, collect or remove a local support envelope built from an Editor
diagnostic ZIP.

options.name: --mode
options.description:
preview lists what would be collected, collect writes the envelope,
and remove verifies and deletes it. [default: preview]

options.name: --editor-diagnostics
options.description: The Editor diagnostic ZIP to read. Required by preview and collect.

options.name: --destination
options.description: The support envelope JSON file. Required by collect and remove.
